title: juphyter
tagline: A Jupyter and Quarto kernel for PHP.
summary: juphyter runs PHP cells in JupyterLab notebooks and in Quarto documents. It registers a Jupyter kernel, so JupyterLab lists PHP in its launcher and Quarto runs the {php} cells of a .qmd that names the kernel. It corresponds to IRkernel, which runs R in Jupyter.

One PHP session lasts across cells, including use imports and declared functions and classes. A cell's last value is its output: a phibble data frame appears as an HTML table and a phiz plot as a chart, and tracebacks name the cell and the line. A notebook inside a Composer project can use that project's classes and packages, because the kernel loads the nearest vendor/autoload.php above it.

optional.name: pcntl PHP extension
optional.for: interrupting a running cell with the stop button

optional.name: vl-convert
optional.for: static phiz plot images in PDF and Word output

optional.name: phibble, phplyr, and phiz
optional.for: data frame tables and charts in notebooks

verify.output:
JupyterLab: ready, with php.
Quarto: ready.
